SATORI_KOISHI_NOTE.title: Koishi's Note
SATORI_KOISHI_NOTE.description: The first time you Exhaust a Memory card each combat, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
SATORI_KOISHI_NOTE.flavor: There is only one line on the note: “Sis, I'm going out to play.”
SATORI_HEART_BELL.title: Heartvoice Bell
SATORI_HEART_BELL.description: The first time you Read Mind each turn, apply 2 Mental Load to that enemy.
SATORI_HEART_BELL.flavor: Perhaps an unheard voice can still make it ring softly.
SATORI_UNCONSCIOUS_HAT.title: Unconscious Hat
SATORI_UNCONSCIOUS_HAT.description: The first time an enemy loses all Suggestion each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
SATORI_UNCONSCIOUS_HAT.flavor: Beneath the brim, there is no answer—only a breeze that has just passed.
SATORI_PALACE_KEY.title: Key to the Palace of the Earth Spirits
SATORI_PALACE_KEY.flavor: Tezcatara has kept a door home open for you.
THIRD_EYE.title: Third Eye
THIRD_EYE.description: At the start of your first 2 turns, Read Mind a random enemy.
THIRD_EYE.flavor: Unspoken thoughts are already reflected in the eye.
SATORI_OPEN_THIRD_EYE.title: Eye of the Heart
SATORI_OPEN_THIRD_EYE.description: At the start of each turn, Read Mind all enemies.
SATORI_OPEN_THIRD_EYE.flavor: Orobas's touch makes every voice rush in at once.
SATORI_BOOKMARK.title: Read-Mind Bookmark
SATORI_BOOKMARK.description: The first time you play a Memory card each combat, draw a card.
SATORI_BOOKMARK.flavor: Mark this page. There is no need to turn it just yet.
SATORI_RED_SPOOL.title: Red Thread Spool
SATORI_RED_SPOOL.description: At the start of combat, apply 3 Suggestion to ALL enemies.
SATORI_RED_SPOOL.flavor: Before a word is spoken, the red thread has reached the heartstrings.
SATORI_HELL_EMBER.title: Old Hell Ember
SATORI_HELL_EMBER.description: The first time you play an Attack Memory each turn, deal additional damage equal to the target's Mental Load.
SATORI_HELL_EMBER.flavor: The flame is only a shape. Its fuel is every thought left behind.
SATORI_TEACUP.title: Palace Teacup
SATORI_TEACUP.description: At the start of combat, gain 1 Mind Echo.
SATORI_TEACUP.flavor: A cup of hot tea brings the tangled voices into focus.
SATORI_LOST_HEART.title: A Lost Heartstring
SATORI_LOST_HEART.description:
After defeating every Act 3 boss, enter Act 4: The Unnoticed Garden.
Restore all missing HP once on entry (80% at Ascension 2+).
Only one heartstring is needed. Burning elites stop appearing while you hold it.
SATORI_LOST_HEART.flavor: A thread she left without thinking finally has someone at the other end.
SATORI_PRECIOUS_MEMORY.title: A Precious Memory
SATORI_PRECIOUS_MEMORY.description: In Act 4’s visitors event, you may ask both Orin and Okuu to join the final battle.
SATORI_PRECIOUS_MEMORY.flavor: The footsteps outside have faded from memory. The laughter inside has not.
